message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The defendant fabricated traffic accidents to obtain insurance money. This is insurance fraud. Under Chinese criminal law, "诈骗" (fraud) specifically "保险诈骗罪" is a type of fraud. The appropriate charge is "诈骗罪" (fraud) or "保险诈骗罪". Usually in Chinese criminal law, "诈骗罪" covers insurance fraud. Could also be "伪造交通事故" maybe "伪造证件罪"? But main is fraud. Also possibly "伪造文书罪"? He forged accidents, but the core is fraud to obtain insurance money. So charge: 诈骗罪. Could be "诈骗罪（保险诈骗）". The format: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.

If multiple: maybe also "伪造交通事故" not a separate crime. So single.
